subject.title: fix(agents): apply stale-run liveness check to aborted subagent orphan recovery

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for stale restart-aborted subagent runs, including the upgrade behavior that old persisted rows become pruned or terminal instead of resume-eligible?
rationale: The code path appears mechanically sound, but it intentionally changes persisted session-state and parent-visible recovery semantics, and another open candidate PR targets the same bug.

options.title: Accept this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this branch after maintainer review and close or retarget the overlapping stale-recovery PRs.

options.title: Preserve legacy recovery by default
options.body: Ask for a revised contract that keeps stale restart-aborted rows resumable unless an explicit migration or policy gate retires them.

options.title: Use the sibling implementation
options.body: Choose the other open stale-recovery branch if maintainers prefer its narrower recovery contract or proof path.

recommendation.title: Accept this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this branch after maintainer review and close or retarget the overlapping stale-recovery PRs.
